responsibility: Implements the Solaris C++ mangling-context hook used to preserve historical Solaris libstdc++ ABI. It detects a small fixed set of system structure types that would otherwise move into namespace std under newer header behavior and forces their mangling context back to the global namespace. This file is narrowly about Solaris C++ ABI compatibility in name mangling, unlike sol2-c.c pragmas or sol2.c backend assembly helpers.
